notes: Mid-market product company building an in-app assistant and enhanced search for their SaaS product. Started Hosted API trial Jan 2026; engineering-led eval with product PM and infra manager involved. Priority: predictable latency and cost control rather than bleeding-edge model quality. Wants same API surface if we move to Dedicated. Trial highlights: steady-state traffic small but representative (avg 8-12 QPS), spike tests hit ~45 QPS; primary traffic is chat/generation from users and internal rerank requests for recommendations. Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 posture and audit logs, key material in customer KMS, and EU data residency for a subset of customers. Wants VPC option for Dedicated. AE/SE have run initial pricing scenarios and showed Dedicated will reduce per-token cost ~35% at target volumes.

qps_forecast: Customer forecast (internal): steady 60 QPS by launch, peak 150 QPS during marketing spikes; baseline trial currently 8-12 QPS. Expect 20-30% month-over-month feature adoption in first 3 months after launch.
concurrency_target: Target concurrency 40 active user streams for chat paths; backend batch jobs for rerank limited to 8 concurrent workers.
token_mix: embeddings: 20% (used for async KB updates, avg 1200 tokens/doc)
latency_slos: P95 generation < 150ms desired for simple prompts; acceptable p95 up to 300ms for longer context completions. Embeddings and batch rerank are background and can tolerate higher latency.
dedicated_capacity_request: Customer asking for Dedicated sizing: initial reserved pool equivalent to 4 x 80GB GPUs with autoscale/burst to 8 GPUs for marketing peaks. Assumption: continuous batching + prefix cache will reduce token cost by ~18%. SE to validate kernel/quantization recommendations. Also asked for runway estimate and warm-up plan for cold cache behavior.
cost_sensitivity: High - finance wants clear unit economics. Decision hinges on 12-month TCO vs hosted spend. Interested in Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce commit size.
integration_notes: SDK integration done with node client; engineering reported minor tokenization mismatch for templated prompts; SE advised prompt normalization. Wants route-level per-token billing visibility in Console. Also asked for example rollback policy for model variant fallback.
legal_and_security: Legal requested DPA + SOC2 attestation; security requested architecture diagram for VPC deployment and KMS integration. Asked for retention controls and audit log export sample.
next_internal_steps: Jordan to run Dedicated quote with 3 pricing bands and circulate to VP Product by 2026-03-10; schedule technical sizing workshop with infra team for 2026-03-12.
sales_play_notes: Play: Hosted->Dedicated land pattern. Emphasize predictable SLOs, cost delta, and same API surface. Offer a 3-month proof-of-capacity pilot with reduced commit to mitigate budget blocker. Use Optimize team to produce quantization recommendations post-POC.
